atoms.exact_source_text: The same Supply remains dimensional because different encounters apply its physical character differently.
atoms.normalized_claim: The same Supply remains dimensional because different encounters apply its physical character differently.

atoms.exact_source_text: The encounter supplies the one clear contextual effect.
atoms.normalized_claim: The encounter supplies the one clear contextual effect.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Adopted.**
atoms.normalized_claim: BSA-11 Core Tool Classes is Adopted.

atoms.exact_source_text: The canonical Tool vocabulary contains five functional classes:
atoms.normalized_claim: The canonical Tool vocabulary contains five functional classes.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Carry** | Increase or reorganize personal and party Carry
atoms.normalized_claim: The Carry Tool class function is to increase or reorganize personal and party Carry.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Reach** | Extend contact, control distance, probe, hook, retrieve, or operate across a gap
atoms.normalized_claim: The Reach Tool class function is to extend contact, control distance, probe, hook, retrieve, or operate across a gap.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Cut** | Sever, pierce, scrape, open, divide, or free
atoms.normalized_claim: The Cut Tool class function is to sever, pierce, scrape, open, divide, or free.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Brace** | Support, block, wedge, shield, stabilize, reinforce, or hold
atoms.normalized_claim: The Brace Tool class function is to support, block, wedge, shield, stabilize, reinforce, or hold.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Render** | Process suitable recovered matter into a usable form at a Node
atoms.normalized_claim: The Render Tool class function is to process suitable recovered matter into a usable form at a Node.

atoms.exact_source_text: Each Tool is a persistent personal item occupying the Citizen’s single Tool slot.
atoms.normalized_claim: Each Tool is a persistent personal item occupying the Citizen's single Tool slot.

atoms.exact_source_text: The class defines its mechanical permission.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Tool class defines its mechanical permission.

atoms.exact_source_text: Physical manifestation remains species-specific, material-specific, and provenance-specific.
atoms.normalized_claim: Physical manifestation of a Tool remains species-specific, material-specific, and provenance-specific.

atoms.exact_source_text: Different objects are not separate Tool types unless their function genuinely differs.
atoms.normalized_claim: Different objects are not separate Tool types unless their function genuinely differs.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Render Tool permits suitable material at a Node to be processed in the field.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Render Tool permits suitable material at a Node to be processed in the field.

atoms.exact_source_text: Where the Node explicitly supports it, Render may convert part of a Node yield into the indicated Supply class, prepare recovered matter for safer transport, separate usable material from a hazardous or burdensome whole, or expose a more useful form of the Node’s existing yield.
atoms.normalized_claim: Where the Node explicitly supports it, Render may convert part of a Node yield into the indicated Supply class, prepare recovered matter for safer transport, separate usable material from a hazardous or burdensome whole, or expose a more useful form of the Node's existing yield.

atoms.exact_source_text: Render does not create open-ended Away crafting.
atoms.normalized_claim: Render does not create open-ended Away crafting.

atoms.exact_source_text: It cannot produce arbitrary Supplies, create Tools, Keepsakes, or Special Artifacts, bypass authored Node limits, create additional inventory slots, or operate without credible material to process.
atoms.normalized_claim: Render cannot produce arbitrary Supplies, create Tools, Keepsakes, or Special Artifacts, bypass authored Node limits, create additional inventory slots, or operate without credible material to process.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Node indicates the available Render result.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Node indicates the available Render result.

atoms.exact_source_text: > **RENDER available: Convert part of this windfall into 1 Distraction Supply.**
atoms.normalized_claim: An example Render prompt states: RENDER available: Convert part of this windfall into 1 Distraction Supply.

atoms.exact_source_text: The resulting Supply occupies an empty or already-spent Supply slot.
atoms.normalized_claim: The resulting Supply occupies an empty or already-spent Supply slot.
